prompt.zh-CN: 把四渡赤水做成一支 6 分钟的军事教科书式讲解片：前 30 秒先抛出‘给你重来一次也走不出这条路’的悬念，再铺湘江战役与遵义会议的背景，按一渡到四渡、南渡乌江、佯攻贵阳、巧渡金沙江讲完，最后讲军委二局和三条课。真实高程的 3D 战场飞越配军事地图，画作做视差，低音男声旁白，原创战鼓弦乐配乐，全片称毛泽东为‘教员’。先即时播放给我看。
prompt.en: Make a 6-minute military textbook-style explainer on the Four Crossings of the Chishui. In the first 30 seconds, hook viewers with ‘Even given another try, you could not find your way out along this route.’ Then set up the Xiang River battle and Zunyi Conference, cover crossings one to four, the southward Wu River crossing, the feint at Guiyang and the clever Jinsha River crossing, and finish with the Military Commission’s Second Bureau and three lessons. Use 3D battlefield flyovers based on real elevation, military maps, parallax paintings, a deep male voiceover and original war drums and strings. Call Mao Zedong ‘the Instructor’ throughout. Show me a live preview first.
prompt.zh-Hant: 把四渡赤水做成一支 6 分鐘的軍事教科書式講解片：前 30 秒先拋出「給你重來一次也走不出這條路」的懸念，再鋪湘江戰役與遵義會議的背景，按一渡到四渡、南渡烏江、佯攻貴陽、巧渡金沙江講完，最後講軍委二局和三條課。真實高程的 3D 戰場飛越配軍事地圖，畫作做視差，低音男聲旁白，原創戰鼓弦樂配樂，全片稱毛澤東為「教員」。先即時播放給我看。
prompt.ja: 四渡赤水を、軍事教科書のように解説する6分間の映像にして。最初の30秒で「もう一度やり直せても、この道を抜け出せない」という謎を提示し、湘江の戦いと遵義会議の背景を描いてから、第1〜第4の渡河、烏江の南渡、貴陽への陽動、金沙江の巧みな渡河まで語り、最後に軍事委員会第二局と3つの教訓を紹介して。実際の標高データによる3D戦場の飛行映像と軍事地図、絵画の視差表現、低い男性ナレーション、オリジナルの戦太鼓と弦楽の音楽を使って。毛沢東は全編で「教員」と呼んで。まずライブ再生で見せて。
prompt.ko: 사도적수(적수강 네 차례 도하)를 군사 교과서처럼 설명하는 6분 영상으로 만들어 줘. 첫 30초에는 ‘다시 기회를 줘도 이 길을 빠져나갈 수 없다’는 궁금증을 던지고, 샹강 전투와 쭌이 회의의 배경을 짚어 줘. 1차부터 4차 도하, 우강 남쪽 도하, 구이양 양동 공격, 진사강 도하까지 설명한 뒤 군사위원회 제2국과 세 가지 교훈으로 마무리해. 실제 고도 데이터의 3D 전장 비행과 군사 지도, 그림의 시차 효과, 낮은 남성 내레이션, 창작 전투 북과 현악 음악을 써 줘. 마오쩌둥은 영상 내내 ‘교원’이라고 불러 줘. 먼저 실시간 재생으로 보여 줘.
prompt.es: Haz un video de 6 minutos sobre los cuatro cruces del Chishui, explicado como un manual militar. En los primeros 30 segundos, engancha con «Aunque pudieras intentarlo otra vez, no lograrías salir por esta ruta». Presenta la batalla del Xiang y la Conferencia de Zunyi; cuenta los cruces del primero al cuarto, el cruce del Wu hacia el sur, la finta sobre Guiyang y el ingenioso cruce del Jinsha. Termina con el Segundo Buró de la Comisión Militar y tres lecciones. Usa vuelos 3D sobre el campo de batalla con elevación real, mapas militares, pinturas con paralaje, una voz masculina grave y música original de tambores de guerra y cuerdas. Llama a Mao Zedong «el Instructor» durante todo el video. Muéstrame primero la vista previa en vivo.
prompt.de: Mach einen 6-minütigen Erklärfilm über die vier Überquerungen des Chishui, wie ein militärisches Lehrbuch. Wecke in den ersten 30 Sekunden Spannung: „Selbst bei einem zweiten Versuch würdest du diesen Weg nicht hinausfinden.“ Erkläre die Schlacht am Xiang und die Zunyi-Konferenz, dann die erste bis vierte Überquerung, den Wu-Übergang nach Süden, das Täuschungsmanöver gegen Guiyang und den geschickten Jinsha-Übergang. Schließe mit dem Zweiten Büro der Militärkommission und drei Lehren. Nutze 3D-Flüge über das Schlachtfeld mit echten Höhendaten, Militärkarten, Gemälde mit Parallaxe, eine tiefe Männerstimme und eigene Musik aus Kriegstrommeln und Streichern. Nenne Mao Zedong durchgehend „den Lehrer“. Zeig mir zuerst die Live-Vorschau.
prompt.fr: Fais un film explicatif de 6 minutes sur les quatre traversées du Chishui, comme un manuel militaire. Dans les 30 premières secondes, accroche avec « Même en recommençant, vous ne trouveriez pas la sortie par cet itinéraire ». Pose le contexte de la bataille du Xiang et de la conférence de Zunyi, puis raconte les quatre traversées, le passage du Wu vers le sud, la feinte sur Guiyang et l’astucieuse traversée du Jinsha. Termine par le Deuxième Bureau de la Commission militaire et trois leçons. Utilise des survols 3D du champ de bataille fondés sur des altitudes réelles, des cartes militaires, des peintures en parallaxe, une voix masculine grave et une musique originale de tambours de guerre et de cordes. Appelle Mao Zedong « l’Instructeur » tout au long du film. Montre-moi d’abord l’aperçu en direct.
prompt.pt-BR: Faça um vídeo de 6 minutos sobre as quatro travessias do Chishui, explicado como um manual militar. Nos primeiros 30 segundos, prenda a atenção com ‘Mesmo tentando de novo, você não conseguiria sair por essa rota’. Apresente a batalha do Xiang e a Conferência de Zunyi; conte da primeira à quarta travessia, a passagem do Wu rumo ao sul, a finta sobre Guiyang e a engenhosa travessia do Jinsha. Termine com o Segundo Departamento da Comissão Militar e três lições. Use sobrevoos 3D do campo de batalha com elevação real, mapas militares, pinturas com paralaxe, narração masculina grave e música original de tambores de guerra e cordas. Chame Mao Zedong de ‘o Instrutor’ durante todo o vídeo. Mostre primeiro a prévia ao vivo.

tools.tool: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / OpenStreetMap / Natural Earth

rounds.zh-CN: 把四渡赤水做成军事教科书式的视频，先找文档、写脚本、查资料，做成我们最好的一支宣传片，时长你定，模型你定。
rounds.en: Make the Four Crossings of the Chishui into a military textbook-style video. Find documents, write the script and research it first. Make it our best promotional film; you choose the length and the models.

rounds.zh-CN: 这次样片要超越以往所有效果。
rounds.en: This sample should surpass all our previous visual results.

rounds.zh-CN: 画面可以用 3D 能力切换镜头，不要只是平移放大几张图。
rounds.en: Use 3D capabilities to change camera angles, instead of just panning and zooming across a few pictures.

rounds.zh-CN: 要用小篇幅铺长征前的失败，特别是湘江战役；完整故事加炫酷画面都要；儿童、成人、军迷都喜欢；全片称毛泽东为"教员"。
rounds.en: Briefly establish the failures leading up to the campaign, especially the Xiang River battle. Include both the full story and striking visuals, appealing to children, adults and military enthusiasts. Call Mao Zedong ‘the Instructor’ throughout.

rounds.zh-CN: 开篇就讲"为什么叫神来之笔，重来一次也指挥不出"，前 5 秒、10 秒、30 秒最重要，脚本要能留住人。
rounds.en: Open with ‘Why is it called a stroke of genius, one you could not command again even with another try?’ The first 5, 10 and 30 seconds matter most; the script must hold viewers’ attention.

rounds.zh-CN: 配音用 Gemini，低沉的军事解说腔；试听后选了 Orus 原声，降调版太沉不用。
rounds.en: Use Gemini for a deep military documentary voiceover. After auditioning, choose the original Orus voice; the pitch-lowered version is too deep, so leave it out.
Turn it into a sample and ship it with the app.

zh-CN.when: 修音或复用配音种子改变时间轴时
zh-CN.request: 制作目标摘要：修正读音同时保留既有配乐效果。
zh-CN.problem: 修音后总长375.367变376.933秒，部分后续幕起点晚1秒，旧音乐仍依旧时间表。
zh-CN.change: 读取最终修音任务的时间轴，本地重剪既有源曲。
zh-CN.principle: 素材复用要核对依赖；声音变了，检查音乐、字幕和事件锚点。
zh-CN.cost: 本次本地剪辑18.591秒，无新增模型调用；只是该步骤耗时，不是全片制作耗时。
zh-CN.counterexample: 无依赖变化的部分可复用；不能每次小改都整片重新生成。
zh-CN.verification: 新配乐长度与最终时间轴一致；已知错位修复，人耳听感仍未验。

zh-CN.when: 同文本缓存命中却仍出现旧读音时
zh-CN.request: 制作目标摘要：使用已修正的声音，不新增配音。
zh-CN.problem: 旧工作区同键缓存已污染，种子只填缺失文件，会继续命中旧音。
zh-CN.change: 在本片确实允许忽略额外尾参的custom-command中以voice-r2区分身份，86句已有WAV重映射；不覆盖旧缓存。
zh-CN.principle: 命中率不是正确率；缓存身份需反映会改变结果的输入，并验证旧缓存环境。
zh-CN.cost: 本次0新合成，需检查键映射与原WAV；不因此声称全片零token。
zh-CN.counterexample: 不能对任意命令追加尾参；通用缓存策略未扩改，其他模型/音色/发音规则须另核对。
zh-CN.verification: 空缓存和保留旧污染缓存的副本均376.933秒，runtimeErrors=0，86/86命中；本片无逐字对齐，不宣称已逐字验证。

zh-CN.when: 修音、复用种子或命中旧缓存时
zh-CN.request: 当前复刻建议，非当时原话：保留声音品质并按实际授权使用配音。
zh-CN.problem: 种子只是已有录音；无可用同音色来源时，改句不能靠种子生成，混换声音也会破坏一致性。
zh-CN.change: 保留未改句；新句需同音色来源，缓存要反映模型、音色、文字和发音规则，命中后仍核对实际声音。
zh-CN.principle: 系统语音（macOS say / System voice）许可仅限个人非商业，只作草稿试听，不默认、不交付。依次查原声种子、已配置兼容服务或 Agent 的 Gemini TTS/ElevenLabs、本机神经语音；直装版 Qwen/Kokoro 另装，商店无 Qwen。全无则字幕与有许可配乐，告知改善方式，不回系统。完整策略见 galanty://guide/craft、galanty://environment。
zh-CN.cost: 先给免费可用方案；云端会收到旁白，先估费并获用户同意，沿用已有授权。空预算不授权收费，编译免费不代表云端免费。
zh-CN.counterexample: 用户可选不同表现；选了声音后不能擅自混音色，系统试听不构成交付授权。
zh-CN.verification: 当前选声建议；保留本片历史工具与费用记录，本次未新增合成或完整试听，不把历史验收当新句验收。

en.when: Pronunciation fixes or reused voice seeds change the timeline.
en.request: Production goal summary: correct pronunciation while retaining the existing score.
en.problem: Duration changed from 375.367 to 376.933 seconds; some later scenes started one second later while music used the old timing.
en.change: Re-edit existing music locally against the final corrected voice timeline.
en.principle: Check dependencies when reusing assets: changed speech can affect music, subtitles and event cues.
en.cost: This local edit took 18.591 seconds and no model calls; it is not total production time.
en.counterexample: Reuse unaffected parts; a small change need not regenerate the whole film.
en.verification: Music length matched the final timeline and the known timing mismatch was repaired; human listening remained unverified.

en.when: A cache hit still returns old pronunciation.
en.request: Production goal summary: reuse corrected audio without synthesizing more.
en.problem: An old workspace contained stale audio under the same key; filling only missing seed entries retained the stale audio.
en.change: For this custom command, which safely ignores extra trailing arguments, use voice-r2 to distinguish identity and remap 86 existing WAVs without overwriting old cache.
en.principle: A hit is not proof of correctness; cache identity must reflect result-changing inputs, and stale-cache workspaces need checking.
en.cost: Zero new synthesis in this repair; mapping and WAV identity still required review. This does not imply zero tokens for the film.
en.counterexample: Do not append arguments to arbitrary commands. Shared cache policy was not changed; other models, voices and pronunciation rules need separate checks.
en.verification: Clean-cache and stale-cache copies both compiled to 376.933 seconds with zero runtime errors and 86/86 hits; this film lacked word alignment.

en.when: Correcting speech, reusing seeds or checking old cache hits.
en.request: Current reproduction advice, not a historical quote: preserve voice quality within actual authorization.
en.problem: Seeds are existing recordings, not generators. Edited lines need a matching source; mixing replacement voices can break consistency.
en.change: Keep unchanged lines; new lines need the same voice source. Cache identity reflects model, voice, text and pronunciation rules; listen even after a hit.
en.principle: System voices (macOS say / System voice) are licensed only for personal non-commercial use: draft auditions, never defaults or delivery. Prefer seeds, then a configured compatible service or Agent Gemini TTS/ElevenLabs, then local neural voices. Qwen/Kokoro require separate direct-edition installation; store has no Qwen. Otherwise use subtitles and licensed music, explain upgrades and never fall back to system voices. See galanty://guide/craft and galanty://environment.
en.cost: Offer available free options first. Cloud services receive narration; estimate cost and obtain consent, reusing existing authorization. An empty budget authorizes no charges; free compilation is not free cloud speech.
en.counterexample: Users can choose another treatment. Do not mix voices silently or treat a system-voice audition as delivery authorization.
en.verification: Current guidance only. Historical tools and costs remain unchanged; no new synthesis or full listening was performed here, and old approval does not approve new lines.
